name: CRITICAL WARNING: Texas Roadhouse Rattlesnake Bites (Deep-Fried Jalapeños)
whyItWorks: Diced spicy jalapeño peppers with seeds mixed with Monterrey Jack cheese, coated in breading, deep-fried in commercial soybean oil, and served with spicy Cajun horseradish dip. Capsaicin, grease, and dairy fat create an acute toxic triad for ulcerated intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid Rattlesnake Bites. They are one of the single most damaging appetizers on any American casual dining menu.
